releases.notes:
## What's New in 1.4
- **Harvest Aura System Improvements**: Significantly improved scanning and harvesting efficiency in Harvest (Risky) mode.
- **Crop Memory Queue**: Added intelligent memory for unplanted farm spots. In large farms, missing crops are remembered and automatically replanted as soon as seeds become available in your inventory.
- **General Bugfixes & Stability Improvements**: Fixed keybind registration fallbacks and inventory slot sync issues.

## Multi-Version Compatibility
This release contains compiled  assets for Minecraft versions **1.21.6 through 1.21.11**.
